rule_notes: NIKL MCFAQ directly confirms the particle phrase 삶의 as [살믜] and also permits [살메] under Standard Pronunciation Rule §5. Park, Cho & Han (2016) analyzed 2,370 Seoul-Corpus /ɨi/ tokens; among 628 monophthongized genitive-particle -의 tokens, 602 (95.86%) were [e]. Thus sal.me is the statistically common spontaneous-speech candidate, while sal.mi remains a NIKL-permitted reading and the UGTPHON annotation. These are population-level observations, not a speaker-specific adjudication of this token; NIKL supplies Hangul, not IPA. Ukrainian target remains provisional and gated.
variant_note: NIKL alternatives 삶의[살믜]/[살메]; Park et al. 2016 found [e] in 602/628 monophthongized genitive -의 tokens (95.86%); this is not exact-speaker evidence.
